show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/Htzd9e
show.description: To escape a forced marriage, Ishita impulsively marries Yuvraj, a poor construction worker with no past or identity. What begins as a marriage of convenience soon changes when hidden truths surface. Yuvraj is not an ordinary laborer but one of the world’s richest men, betrayed by his own family and stripped of his memory. As power, greed, and revenge collide, Ishita must choose between wealth and trust, while Yuvraj fights to reclaim his life and protect the woman who believed in him first.
